description: Account Management centralizes HCP and HCO relationships with key profile information: contact details, professional networks, specialties, affiliations, licenses, ratings, territories, products, and team assignments. The platform extends the standard Account data model with industry-specific fields for a holistic customer view. HealthcareProvider object contains provider-specific attributes including speaker designation.
setup_steps: Enable Person Accounts (irreversible org-wide setting)
Configure record types for HCP, HCO, and patient account types
Set up provider affiliation relationships
Configure care specialty assignments
Enable expert designation tracking
Set up account team member assignments
gotchas: Person Accounts must be enabled BEFORE go-live - this is irreversible
Mixed model (Person Account for individuals + Business Account for orgs) breaks reports/list views built around a single Account concept - plan record types upfront
HealthcareProvider object (not Account) contains speaker designation flag
Define matching keys (MRN, national ID, email+DOB) BEFORE enabling duplicate rules
migration_relevance: Veeva Account_vod maps to Account with HealthcareProvider extension. Account type field mapping requires careful record type planning.

description: Provider Cards consolidate key account information from multiple objects and fields into a single user-friendly view. Cards show whether an account is a target account in the assigned territory alongside other key attributes. Provider Cards are the designed solution for quick account-level information display, not custom components.
setup_steps: Configure Provider Card fields and layout
Set up target account indicators
Configure territory-specific card content
Enable on account profile pages
gotchas: Provider Cards are the standard approach - do not build custom LWC for this use case
Card content can vary by territory assignment
migration_relevance: Maps to Veeva Account Profile page. Provider Card provides more configuration than Veeva static layout.

description: Account Summarization uses AI templates to create cross-object summaries for accounts. Uses field history tracking to include latest changes for configured fields. Persona-specific configuration ensures different user types see relevant summaries - custom objects can be excluded from influencing provider summaries for specific user personas.
setup_steps: Configure Account Summarization template
Enable field history tracking for fields that should appear in summaries
Set up persona-specific summary configurations
Configure cross-object graph for summary generation
gotchas: Field history tracking MUST be enabled for fields to appear in summaries
Persona-specific configuration prevents irrelevant custom objects from influencing summaries
Summary generation requires platform AI licenses
migration_relevance: No direct Veeva equivalent - this is a net-new AI capability on the target platform.

description: KAM helps Key Account Managers build and execute structured strategies for important customers. KAMs can create account and territory plans, define business objectives, assign tasks, and track progress across global, affiliate, and territory levels. Strategic Goals, Action Plan Templates, and Sprint execution cycles provide a framework for coordinated engagement.
setup_steps: Configure account plan templates
Define strategic goal frameworks
Create action plan templates for standardized planning
Set up sprint execution cycles (typically two-week cycles)
Configure sprint completion values in Admin Console under KAM settings
gotchas: Sprint completion values are configured in Admin Console under KAM sprint settings, not custom metadata
Action Plan Template Assignment is the correct object for importing predefined strategic goals
Sprint cycles support two-week execution by default
migration_relevance: Veeva Account Plan maps to AccountPlan with significantly more structured planning capabilities.

description: Activity Plans define target interaction counts per account segment per time period. Plans define target accounts, planning period, required activity types, associated products, and weight of each activity. Provider Plan Cycle is the usage type for strategic planning cycles. Plans must be approved before execution. Employees track progress and can request modifications if business priorities change.
setup_steps: Configure Activity Plan with Usage Type = Provider Plan Cycle for strategic cycles
Define time period configuration
Set up Activity Plan Categories and Criteria
Enable calculation in Admin Console
Configure plan approval workflow
Set plan status to In Progress after approval
gotchas: Usage Type MUST match Provider Plan Cycle for the dashboard to show activities
Time Period configuration must be correct
Calculation must be enabled in Admin Console
Plan Status must be In Progress
Rep assignment and territory alignment must be correct
Activity Plan criteria JSON is DISJOINTED from the OOTB batch calculation job - custom criteria may not be automatically picked up
migration_relevance: Veeva Activity_Plan_vod maps to ActivityPlan. Criteria-based attainment calculation differs significantly.

description: A visit contributes to actual count and attainment if it meets ANY configured criteria. For example: Detail Call (In Person, Completed) and Touchpoint (In Person or Phone Call, Completed) both contribute. A single visit cannot have both Detail and Touchpoint values simultaneously. Attainment calculation runs based on configured criteria matching. The criteria JSON stored on Activity Plan Category/Criteria configuration drives which visits count.
setup_steps: Define criteria JSON for each activity plan category
Configure visit attributes that contribute to attainment
Enable attainment calculation batch job
Test with sample visit data
gotchas: A visit contributes if it meets ANY configured criteria - not ALL
A single visit CANNOT have both Detail and Touchpoint values simultaneously
Custom criteria in JSON may NOT be picked up by standard calculation logic
Batch calculation job must be scheduled and running
migration_relevance: Veeva Call2_vod attainment maps to criteria-based calculation. The JSON criteria model is more flexible but requires careful configuration.

description: Medical Inquiries captures, routes, and manages questions from HCPs, patients, and consumers. Types include medical information requests, adverse events, product quality complaints, and product use/safety questions. Multi-channel origin (in-person, remote, contact center). MIRF Share Management batch job manages sharing for medical inquiry records across territories. MedicalInsightSharingHandler manages collaboration and access by territory.
setup_steps: Configure medical inquiry record types
Set up routing rules to medical experts
Enable MIRF Share Management batch job
Configure MedicalInsightSharingHandler for territory sharing
Set up medical inquiry response workflows
gotchas: After territory reorganization, reps may lose access to historical Medical Inquiry records - run MIRF Share Management job
MIRF Share Management is the specific batch job for medical inquiry sharing - not standard sharing rules
MedicalInsightSharingHandler handles territory-based collaboration for medical insights
migration_relevance: Veeva Medical_Inquiry_vod maps to MedicalInquiry. Sharing model differs significantly from Veeva territory-based access.

topic: Medical Insight Capture and Subject Management
description: Medical Insights captures observations from HCPs, research, meetings, calls, and other interactions. Insights reveal patient needs, evaluate scientific concepts, identify care challenges, and highlight regional practice differences. Users organize insights with tags, voting on relevance, and linking related observations. Subject Management is the standard approach for organizing Medical Insights by topic.
setup_steps: Configure Medical Insight capture forms
Set up Subject Management for topic organization
Configure tagging and voting capabilities
Enable insight sharing across territories
Set up insight analytics and trend reporting
gotchas: Subject Management is the STANDARD approach for organizing by topic - do not build custom taxonomy
Insight sharing requires MedicalInsightSharingHandler configuration
migration_relevance: Veeva Medical_Event_vod maps partially. Medical Insights is more structured with built-in subject management.

topic: Next Best Customer and Next Best Message
description: Next Best Customer component on homepage helps reps prioritize accounts for outreach. Distance-based sorting requires geolocation data on account addresses. Next Best Message uses product-message scoring data at the territory-account-product-message level. External predictive models can feed scoring data. The platform uses Life Sciences-specific Next Best components, not standard platform NBA components.
setup_steps: Configure Next Best Customer component on homepage
Enable geolocation data on account address fields for distance sorting
Set up Next Best Message scoring at territory-account-product-message level
Configure external model integration if using custom predictive models
Use Life Sciences-specific NBA components, not standard platform components
gotchas: Distance-based sorting REQUIRES geolocation data on account address - missing geocode means no distance sorting
Must use Life Sciences-specific Next Best components, NOT standard platform Next Best Action
External predictive model data must be loaded at territory-account-product-message level granularity
migration_relevance: Veeva Suggestion_vod maps partially to Next Best Customer/Message. AI-driven recommendations are net-new capability.
